name: Institute of Physics, Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz

summary.plain: The physics institute of the University of Mainz, Germany, where the Mainz neutrino-mass experiment ran its tritium beta-decay spectrometer.
summary.technical: Surface site: Institut für Physik, Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz (Staudingerweg 7), host of the Mainz MAC-E-filter tritium beta-spectroscopy experiment.
